what: Two traps met while making the engine's Scripts stage. (1) engine_units.rs `discover` published the UnitGraph record without the crate-list section work.rs's UnitGraph arm seals onto it (work.rs `seal_graph`), so every reader that opens the record's two sections through the store (a Script job, a proc-macro module's lookup: graph_payload.rs `sections`) would have been refused 'no trailer mark'. (2) tests/build_scripts.rs, the one test of a member build script run by a command, fails on the green tree for the OLD `blaze check` too: the member app's build.rs is not seen as a script at all (no lookup failure, no cfg: 'cannot find function `made`'), so no binary test can run a script today.
cost: about twenty minutes reading; (2) is not diagnosed (no runs in a lane: the cause is somewhere between the layout's `RawBuild::Auto` listing, the unit graph's `build_script` and blaze-world list.rs `Script::Read`)
cause: (1) two producers of one record (work.rs and engine_units.rs) with the sealing step in only one; (2) unknown
whys: (1) the record's form is assembled at its producer instead of by one function both call
class: a record made in two places, one copy missing a step
prevention: (1) done: discover seals with the same `seal_graph`; better: one function `graph_record(made, world)` that both call (rule 30). (2) owed: a lane with runs bisects build_scripts.rs on the green history
annoyance: a test file that is red on green is invisible until a lane asks for it
workaround: admitted the stage with the engine_check and scripts unit tests; the build_scripts tests (two new for engine-check) wait on (2)
